column1: # Omniglot characters mapped to Unicode code points, made by hand from the drawings.
# Columns: alphabet, character number (the characterNN folder), code point, note.
# An empty code point means the character is not used; the note says why.
# Latin, Greek and Cyrillic are the lowercase letters in alphabetical order; Hebrew uses
# the non-final letter forms; Jawi follows the standard 40-letter Jawi order.
# Old Church Slavonic uses the capital code point where the drawn shape is the capital.
